UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

availableWidth

Returns the parent's horizontal content-box width in px — the space the title is actually allowed to occupy. Falls back to the host's own clientWidth when the element has no parent (detached / test mounts).

  • @param host — the draw-text element
  • @returns available width in px, 0 when unmeasurable

widestWord

Returns the widest word span inside the shadow root in px. Words are inline-block + nowrap, so their rect is the true overflow source — the line itself wraps legally at the space tokens.

  • @param host — the draw-text element
  • @returns widest .draw-text__word width in px

fitText

Measures and (only when overflowing) scales the host's font size and letter spacing so the widest word fits the parent's content box. Clears the inline overrides first so re-measurement is always relative to the stylesheet ramp. No-ops without the fit attribute, without a measurable box, or when the text already fits.

  • @param host — the draw-text element

fitQueue

Pending batch of hosts whose fit pass was deferred to the next frame. A Set dedupes repeated triggers (attribute change + observer in the same task) so each host measures once per flush.

fitRafId

rAF handle for the queued batch — 0 means no flush is scheduled.

applyFit

Applies the computed scale for one host — the write half of the batched flush, fed by values captured in the read phase so the loop is pure writes (a getComputedStyle here would re-interleave read → write).

  • @param host — the draw-text element
  • @param m — measurements captured in the read phase

(module scope)

Measurements captured in the flush's read phase for one host.

avail

Parent content-box width in px.

widest

Widest .draw-text__word width in px.

baseFont

Host font size at the stylesheet ramp, px.

baseSpacing

Host letter-spacing at the stylesheet ramp, px (normal → 0).

measureFit

Reads every layout/style value applyFit needs for one host — kept in a single place so the flush's middle phase is pure reads.

  • @param host — the draw-text element
  • @returns the host's measurements for the write phase

flushFits

Flushes every queued host in three strict phases — clear all inline overrides, read all measurements, then write all scales. Running the passes back-to-back inside one rAF turns the mount-time N × (write → read → write) layout thrash into a single style/layout/paint cycle. Hosts disconnected before the flush are skipped via the mounted flag.

scheduleFit

Queues a fit pass for the host on the next animation frame instead of measuring synchronously. All draw-text siblings mount in the same task batch; coalescing their fits prevents sequential forced reflows — the synchronous fitText remains available for callers that already hold a stable layout (and for the test suite's deterministic asserts).

  • @param host — the draw-text element

setupFit

Installs the fit pipeline for a fitted host: immediate measure, a ResizeObserver on the parent (the sizing constraint) for breakpoint / orientation changes, and a one-shot refit once webfonts finish loading (late font swaps can widen the same word by several percent).

  • @param host — the draw-text element

teardownFit

Disconnects the fit observer, drops any queued batch entry, and restores the stylesheet font sizing — called on disconnect and when the fit attribute is removed.

  • @param host — the draw-text element
